title: Implement experimental pure Kotlin RFC 9382 SPAKE2 and isolated legacy SPAKE25519
body:
## 第二轮稳定化 — 固定候选 5910529 正在最终 CI 验收

PR 保持 **Draft**。13 个生产 commonMain 文件与 b837aba 逐字节相同；本轮的修改集中于独立验证、跨平台执行、Maven 发布和真实下游消费。没有修改 Kadb、仓库可见性、AGPL-3.0-only 许可、main 或创建正式 Release。

### 当前源码与 CI

- 当前候选：[59105290820bcbfd4e0336a2e7713006a461527f](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/59105290820bcbfd4e0336a2e7713006a461527f)，对应候选版本 `0.1.0-dev.59105290820b`。
- 正在运行：[完整核心回归](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/actions/runs/40388080241) · [Android ART API 23/35](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/actions/runs/40388080295) · [33 个 Maven 发布单元及两套独立消费者](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/actions/runs/40388080222)。
- 尚未将上述新运行记为通过。最终结论会核对原始日志、XML、依赖变体和产物来源后更新。

### 已验证的修复和证据

- [b46b288](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/b46b288896ffd83b15660c8faa4078e767b1ad6b)：Oracle 输出截断及 Python `-O` 漏检修复；严格重放固定 BoringSSL C 可执行文件，512 历史交换及新增/恶意输入记录保持一致。
- [c539ae6](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/c539ae6bb6eddd026aa9a3c884bd78f328eebc0d)、[a650535](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/a650535f27461b3bfd4c3195f210d6b8971ff340)、[027d6dc](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/027d6dc00f2c92502ca98b878d1940a358590be5)：建立并修正三模块发布、完整源码/许可、Android 资源任务依赖和 Native 元数据伴随 JAR 校验。
- 027d6dc 的 33 个发布单元已通过实际 CI 检查；其消费者整体运行失败，失败原因与后续修正保存在 [诊断记录](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/59105290820bcbfd4e0336a2e7713006a461527f/docs/round2/evidence/ci/027d6dc/DIAGNOSIS.md)。
- a650535 的 [ART 运行](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/actions/runs/40382198513) 已成功：API 23/35 各 72 项核心/运行时见证 + 5 项 Maven 消费者方法，无失败/错误/跳过；这属于旧候选的真实结果，不能替代当前候选验收。
- 本地独立消费者实际执行 JVM、Linux Native、JS、Wasm、Android Host，每个平台 5 项方法通过。修正依赖检查器后完整命令成功，两个客户端各记录 52 次 Maven 产物选择。见 [原始本地证据](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/tree/59105290820bcbfd4e0336a2e7713006a461527f/docs/round2/evidence/consumer-gate)。
- 当前 47 项 Python 工具测试在普通与优化模式下通过。四个真实 Gradle 探针分别证明：合法 Maven/无关插件项目元数据可接受；SPAKE2 工程替换、协议混用和缺失模块被准确拒绝。见 [探针结果](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/59105290820bcbfd4e0336a2e7713006a461527f/docs/round2/evidence/consumer-resolution-probe/report.json)。

### 验收与发行边界

- 消费者同时覆盖生产者 Kotlin 2.2.21 工具链和 Kadb 当前的 Kotlin 2.4.20 / AGP 9.4.0 / Gradle 9.6.0 / JDK 25；Android SDK 保留 compileSdk 37。
- CI Maven 候选产物与正式远端包发行分开；没有公开发布正式版本、触发候选 JitPack 构建或合并分支。
- 保留实验性定位：未获得外部生产安全审计、严格恒定时间或物理零化保证。
- AGPL 与 Apache 下游组合的义务及政策选项已记录，不能将组合产物宣称为 Apache-only。

## Round 1 delivery — historical baseline

Experimental pure Kotlin Multiplatform implementation is delivered on this branch. The repository was private at that delivery. Round 2 observed it is now Public without changing visibility. This PR remains draft; no merge, release or formal package publication has been performed.

- **Final tested code:** [b837aba27bebc1050965fa124c2efa54b4e4544a](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/b837aba27bebc1050965fa124c2efa54b4e4544a)
- **Final reports/evidence:** [4f17f4f19d470758f8abc882ee8d67bcddcd59b6](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/commit/4f17f4f19d470758f8abc882ee8d67bcddcd59b6)
- **All three CI jobs succeeded:** [40294194097](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/actions/runs/40294194097)
- **[中文交付报告](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/DELIVERY.zh-CN.md)** · [Validation ledger](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/validation.md) · [API contract](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/API.md)

The final report commit changes documentation and retained evidence only; source, tests, build scripts, workflow and dependency lock are identical to b837aba. Its `[skip ci]` marker avoids rerunning the identical implementation. The green run is explicitly attributed to b837aba, not represented as a new run on the report commit. The CI checkout was GitHub's temporary PR test merge ca8fab7; its Git tree equals b837aba's tree 9144c7480ec823844a590bcb304d0d8f5b553128, verified independently. The development branch has not been merged into main.

## What this implements

Three separate Gradle artifacts: root RFC, `:primitives`, and `:legacy`. All cryptographic calculations are in 13 commonMain source files. External production dependencies are Kotlin stdlib only; no core JCA/JCE/JNI/native crypto backend or binary crypto library. Caller-supplied CSPRNG is mandatory.

- RFC 9382 **P-256/SHA256/HKDF/HMAC** and **edwards25519/SHA256/HKDF/HMAC**, with both confirmation directions.
- Canonical application-derived 32-byte big-endian w; no default password hash or MHF policy.
- RFC API releases the 16-byte authenticated key only after successful peer confirmation, once. Failure/reuse/destroy terminate the session.
- Separate explicit Legacy SPAKE25519 API pinned to BoringSSL 9e04aed2d1652441d2c84e85ed21acc05e053260; exact historical scalar/cofactor/encoding/transcript behavior, with deliberate stricter terminal-state policy documented.
- Legacy returns a clearly named **unconfirmed** 64-byte key, requiring surrounding-protocol confirmation. No fallback or shared RFC/Legacy protocol state. Unsafe pre-hardening mode requires explicit selection.
- Original implementation is **AGPL-3.0-only**, without a linking exception. Third-party fixtures/notices retain their own licenses. No Kadb-specific APIs or defaults.

## Actual final-code verification

Every reported executed method had zero failures, errors and skips. Test-method counts do not inflate loops over vector corpora.

| Target | Actual result | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| JVM | **80/80** | RFC 23 / primitives 26 / Legacy 31; local clean run and CI |
| Linux Native x86-64 | **71/71** | Three native test executables; RFC 22 / primitives 19 / Legacy 30 |
| JS / Node | **71/71** | Actual Node execution; local Node 22.0.0; CI runtime version not printed |
| Wasm / Node | **71/71** | Actual KotlinWasmNode execution; full Legacy corpus |
| Android | **71/71**, **three AARs** | Host JVM tests and Android build; no emulator/device/ART run |
| iOS Simulator Arm64 | **71/71** | Actual Apple Silicon simulator on macOS 26.6.2 |
| iOS Arm64 device target | **All three modules compiled** | KLIB compilation only; no physical-device run |
| iOS Simulator x86-64 | Configured | Not executed on the available Arm64 runner |

Commands actually run in CI:

```sh
./gradlew --no-daemon jvmTest linuxX64Test jsNodeTest wasmJsNodeTest
./gradlew --no-daemon -PenableAndroid=true assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest
./gradlew --no-daemon compileKotlinIosArm64 iosSimulatorArm64Test
```

A separate local clean command, `clean jvmTest jsNodeTest wasmJsNodeTest linuxX64Test`, also completed with exit 0: JVM 80, JS 71, Wasm 71 and Native 71, all zero failures/errors/skips. It took **33m4s**, with 122 tasks (106 executed, 16 up-to-date); all target tests actually ran. Its 58 frozen source/build inputs match the tested Git blobs, and the original log/XML and executable hashes are retained.

Gradle wall times: Linux **10m3s** (102/102 tasks executed), Android **58s** (93/93 tasks), iOS **5m37s**. These are build/test durations, not protocol benchmarks. All three downloaded artifact digests were verified; raw job logs, per-method outcomes and XML/source hashes are retained in the repository.

The earlier run40289938442 preserves historical JVM77/Native69/Android69/iOS69 results. Its remaining Linux job was automatically cancelled when the reviewed source revision superseded it; it is not described as a complete passing run. A local incremental compile attempt failed before tests with duplicate declarations; a clean retry of identical source succeeded. The precise compiler-state cause is unestablished and its failed log is retained.

## Independent expectations

- All **4 official RFC Appendix B P-256 vectors**, every requested intermediate through both confirmation MACs.
- **12** RFC Edwards vectors using python-ecdsa 0.19.1 with an independent RFC adapter and hashlib/hmac, whose schedule was first cross-checked against the official P-256 vectors.
- A separate full-torsion affine reference covers all **8** pure low-order encodings and **7** mixed-order inputs.
- Rebuilt pinned BoringSSL C oracle: all **512 historical exchanges / 1,024 endpoints**, **7** deterministic exchanges and **4** peer cases regenerated; **24** fresh exchanges, **108** adversarial/boundary peers and **3** zero/order entropy cases.
- Corrected-source differential rechecks: **671** hash/KDF comparisons (bootstrap Kotlin 2.0.21, separately identified), **4,000** BigInteger field comparisons and **60** Python/OpenSSL P-256 products (Kotlin 2.2.21).
- **87 selected** pinned Wycheproof cases, **12** portable raw-Montgomery carry expectations and **40** JVM raw-product comparisons.
- Wrong password/identity/AAD/role/MAC, malformed and noncanonical points/scalars, entropy faults, reuse/destroy, aliasing, reentrancy, real JVM thread overlap and terminal cleanup regressions.

Reference sources, pinned versions and regeneration commands are in [reference-vectors.md](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/reference-vectors.md) and [LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.md](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.md). External reference implementations are test tools only.

## Findings fixed and reviewed

The review found and corrected a concurrent gate race, confirmation-copy allocation ordering, scalar-copy validation ordering, cleanup publication/allocation issues, bounded-fuzz coverage wording, and IRTF-source licensing attribution.

- **SR-09:** ephemeral sampling now includes canonical zero in the full [0,q) interval. Four independent M/N message expectations check that boundary; degenerate exchanges terminate before key release.
- **SR-10:** secret field multiplication no longer reaches Kotlin/JS boxed Long multiplication. Wrapping Int arithmetic has an explicit carry bound; SHA512 masks bytes before widening. Actual emitted development-test JS and the runtime copies used by Node were inspected and hashed. All final platform regressions passed.

[Security review](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/security-review.md), [math review](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/math-review.md), [carry analysis](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/math-int-carry-review.md), [JS runtime review](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/js-runtime-review.md), [final API review](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/final-api-review.md).

These are author-separated reviews within the same AI-assisted team, **not an external professional audit, formal proof or strict constant-time certification**.

## Remaining limits

- Experimental. JVM/ART, Native, JS and Wasm have no strict constant-time or physical-zeroization guarantee; scheduler interleavings are not model checked.
- No Android device/ART, physical iOS, Intel iOS simulator or browser-engine execution.
- Caller entropy quality and RFC password preprocessing remain application responsibilities; Legacy still needs application confirmation and preserves historical hazards.
- JVM allocation churn remains high. Independently checked full-pair measurements: P256 median182.76ms/28.24MiB allocated, Edwards84.07ms/12.98MiB, Legacy78.48ms/12.81MiB. Small shared-host samples are not throughput, retained-memory or side-channel guarantees; see [performance.md](https://github.com/Flyfish233/spake2/blob/work/spake2-implementation/docs/performance.md).
- P384/P521/Edwards448/SHA512-suite/CMAC extensions are not implemented or advertised.

## Delivery history

Initialization: 783299c; M0: bd3c732; M1: 6c05267; M2/M3: dc6cd08; M4: 6a79f65; M5: 9ce242f; reviewed fixes: b837aba; final evidence: 4f17f4f19d470758f8abc882ee8d67bcddcd59b6. Full linked stage history is in the Chinese delivery report. main remains at its initial commit.
